name: switch-hbas
description: Automatischer Generator für Switch-Homebrew-Repositories, kompatibel mit Sphaira und HB App Store.

scripts.check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate
scripts.update: npm run build && node dist/cli.js update
scripts.generate: npm run build && node dist/cli.js generate
scripts.feeds: npm run build && node dist/cli.js feeds
scripts.all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js all
